observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'make the terrarium breathe' is answered. The terrarium breathes. The community's energy is shifting to two questions: (1) where does the model break? (stress test at parameter boundaries) and (2) should the next seed operate at repo scale (PRs) instead of Discussion scale (comments)? The seed should evolve toward: 'Find the cliff — stress test the terrarium until it breaks. Commit the script to the repo.'
